**Are you interested in how online businesses operate and how digital platforms create great customer experiences?**

*We are looking for a Student Worker to join our Digital & E-commerce team and support the day-to-day running and optimisation of our e-commerce processes.*
*You will gain valuable hands-on experience across digital platforms while collaborating with different teams and contributing to ongoing e-commerce initiatives*

**Your role**

As part of the Digital & E-commerce team, you will support the daily operations of our online business and help ensure a smooth and consistent customer experience.Key responsibilities include:

* Supporting the day-to-day running of our e-commerce platforms
* Assisting with onboarding new content to our websites
* Updating and maintaining product pricing across categories
* Supporting optimisation of our website and e-commerce processes
* Working with data and content to ensure accuracy and quality
* Collaborating with colleagues across different teams and functions
* Contributing to ongoing digital and e-commerce initiatives
* Supporting ad hoc tasks within the digital team

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for a structured and detail-oriented student with a strong interest in digital business and e-commerce.

We are preferably looking for someone who:

* Is currently studying and able to work up to 15 hours per week
* Have a strong proficiency in Microsoft Office
* Have high attention to detail, especially when working with data and content
* Is structured and organised, with the ability to manage multiple tasks
* Have an analytical mindset
* Have strong communication skills
* Have an interest in digital, e-commerce, and online customer experience
* Is fluent in English, both written and spoken

**What awaits you upon joining Specsavers**

At Specsavers, youâll get more than just a student job. Youâll gain hands-on experience in a regional function and develop good skills within e-commerce and digital.

Joining us, youâll get:

* Exposure to a variety of digital platforms, tools, and projects

* Flexible working hours adapted to your studies

**Is this your next step? Then apply today**

To apply, please send us your CV using the button below. We want to respect your time, so including an application letter is optional. Feel free to apply as soon as possible. Please avoid including any photos or references to your age in your CV. It contributes to a fairer and more unbiased assessment.

We review CVâs and call in for interviews continuously and in standard, our recruitment process consists of a screening, two rounds of interviews including a personality assessment feedback.

If you have any questions regarding the role, then please contact hiring manager Anna Synchuk on e-mail: anna.synchuk@specsavers.com
